heroSummary: Howard County Public School System begins the 2025-2026 school year for K-12 students on Monday, August 25, 2025. Pre-K and RECC students begin Thursday, August 28. Spring break runs March 30-April 6, 2026, and the scheduled last day is Monday, June 15, 2026.

calendarNotes: HCPSS starts the 2025-2026 school year for K-12 students on August 25, 2025, while Pre-K and RECC students begin on August 28. The calendar includes several three-hour early closings, including professional learning days, conference days, and late-year work days. Thanksgiving includes student conference days before the two-day holiday closure. Winter break runs December 24, 2025 through January 2, 2026, with schools returning Monday, January 5. Spring break runs March 30-April 6, 2026. The scheduled last day is June 15, 2026, with several late-year early closings listed before that date.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Howard County Public School System start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPSS starts the 2025-2026 school year for K-12 students on Monday, August 25, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When do HCPSS Pre-K and RECC students start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The official HCPSS dates-only calendar lists Thursday, August 28, 2025 as the first day of school for Pre-K and RECC students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is HCPSS Spring Break in 2026?
When is the last scheduled day for HCPSS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day of school is Monday, June 15, 2026. HCPSS lists it as a three-hour early closing and professional work day.

calendarFaqs.q: Which HCPSS dates are easy to miss in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Dates families often miss include early closings on September 17, October 31, November 12, November 24-25, January 22-23, February 5-6, March 3, May 14, June 8, June 11, June 12, and June 15, plus student-only closure dates such as October 17, November 26, January 26, February 4, March 20, and April 15.

calendarFaqs.q: Does HCPSS close for parent-teacher conferences in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. HCPSS lists several conference-related dates, including ES/MS parent-teacher conferences on November 24-25, a student closure on November 26, and elementary-only early closings on February 5-6.
